source: Bucket formula used by the calculator. Weapon damage and weapon-type damage add, then that bucket multiplies. Total weapon damage is a second multiplier (Obliterate, Vigilance, Optimist). Critical hit damage and headshot damage add inside one multiplier when both apply; they do not multiply each other. Each amplified talent is its own multiplier (Glass Cannon, Striker's Gamble). Damage to Armor applies only on the armor pool, Damage to Health only on the health pool, and Damage to Targets Out of Cover is its own multiplier when the out-of-cover assumption is on. Sources: r/thedivision 'Division 2 Damage Calculations: tests and results' (Mar 2019, https://www.reddit.com/r/thedivision/comments/axfo50/division_2_damage_calculations_tests_and_results/); r/Division2 'Is amplified damage and total weapon damage the same?' (Apr 2024, https://www.reddit.com/r/Division2/comments/1c8drah/is_amplified_damage_and_total_weapon_damage_the/); Shade Hub builder spec equation (1 Nov 2026). Weapon innate headshot (the catalog headshot field, 55 on an AR) is part of the headshot term, separate from bonus headshot damage. Expertise is +1% weapon damage per rank on that weapon only (Ubisoft Intelligence Annex, cited in armor.json). Critical hit chance is capped at 60. Reload time is base seconds divided by (1 + reload speed %). The saved Build Station page shows the calculator labels but the numbers are 0 in the static HTML, so the talent coefficients come from that page's calcEffects and the shot totals are checked against this formula.
